test_title: PYST 22: SSC CGL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 21 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
In this question, three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, Il and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follows/follow from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some mirrors are glass.

All glass are taps.

Some taps are pens.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some glass are mirrors.

Il. All taps are glass.

III. Some pens are taps.

options.text: Only conclusions I and Il follow.
Only conclusions I and Ill follow.

solution:
Statements:

Some mirrors are glass.

All glass are taps.

Some taps are pens.
